name: tongue-escape
description: +1 Tongue Escape - browser multiplayer tongue-swinging lava obby (Three.js + Colyseus)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @tongue/server && npm run build --workspace @tongue/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @tongue/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @tongue/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run verify:course && npm run verify:progression && npm run verify:assets
